I will stay with what I usually do on this small rented piece. Since the plot is only 0.29 hectare and cash is tight, I will not buy chemical fertilizer or improved planting material for it; I will use my local cassava and other cuttings I can get nearby and put some compost and household manure where I can. I will depend on the rains, weed mostly by hand, and bring in a few hired hands only for the heavier work because I am old now.
